ValidationRule.description: Expense date must fall within the trip dates. Flights may be booked before the trip starts.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( Expense_Date__c > Trip__r.End_Date__c, AND( NOT( ISPICKVAL( Category__c, "Flight" ) ), Expense_Date__c < Trip__r.Start_Date__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Expense date must be within the trip dates (flights may be booked earlier).
